# Cotton Mesa Trophy Whitetail and Exotic Hunts

> Premier Texas hunting ranch offering trophy whitetail deer and exotic game hunts on 4,200 acres with guided packages and luxury lodge accommodations.

Cotton Mesa Trophy Whitetail Ranch, owned by the Gegenheimers near Dallas, specializes in guided hunting experiences for whitetail deer and a diverse range of exotic game species including African and Asian wildlife. The ranch combines trophy hunting opportunities with full-service lodge facilities and professional outfitting services.
